name: A Gente Se Vê Por Aí
source:
A Gente Se Vê Por Aí is an anthology game aiming to share the voices of LGBTQIA+ people in the city of Belo Horizonte. It's a collaborative project about the city written by several people from the community.

[Translated from [url=https://faisca.itch.io/agsvpa]itch.io[/url]]
